literal_resolution_facts: Frozen description: YES if Sánchez ceases to be PM for any period between market creation and deadline; a resignation/removal announcement before market end resolves YES regardless of its effective date. Detention, effective removal, or permanent prevention from duties also qualifies. Official government/Sánchez information is primary; credible reporting may be used by consensus.
The question deadline is ET 2026-12-31; Gamma end timestamp is 2027-01-01T04:59Z.

dated_primary_facts.fact: La Moncloa agenda page dated 2026-10-19 labels Pedro Sánchez “Presidente del Gobierno” and lists two official activities for that date. This is a dated status/agenda page, not proof against an announcement outside its scope.

Royal Decree 806/2026 is dated 2026-10-05 and published in BOE on 2026-10-06. It dissolves the Congress and Senate elected 2023-07-23 and calls both-chamber elections for Sunday 2026-11-29. Its preamble says it is proposed by the President of Government after Council of Ministers deliberation on 2026-10-05.

Congress constitutional article 101 text says the Government ceases after general elections, constitutionally specified loss of parliamentary confidence, or resignation/death of its President; the outgoing Government continues in functions until the new Government takes office. The source speaks about the Government and caretaker continuity; this packet does not resolve whether/when that legal transition satisfies the market’s person-specific “ceases to be Prime Minister” wording.

Congress release dated 2026-06-25 records passage by points of a political motion that urged considering a confidence question if elections were not called and demanded political responsibility. The page expressly describes the initiative as without legal binding force. It predates the October election decree and is not itself a recorded confidence vote or resignation.

coverage_limit: These four public sources establish the scheduled election and constitutional caretaker rule, plus a dated official-status observation. They do not establish any later resignation/removal announcement or exhaustively rule one out; no absence inference is made.
